footnote_text: On June 30, 2026, the Reporting Person participated in the PIPE Offering indirectly through V-Co Investors 4 LLC ("V-Co 4"), in which he acquired a membership interest. His indirect interest in V-Co 4 represents approximately $50,000 of the aggregate purchase price paid by V-Co 4, corresponding to 85,910 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock and Warrants to purchase 85,910 shares of Common Stock purchased of record by V-Co 4. The securities reported are held of record by V-Co 4. The Preferred Stock is convertible at any time at the holder's election, subject to a beneficial ownership limitation, and has no expiration date. The warrants are exercisable at $0.456 per share through June 30, 2031. The $0.582 price reported is the per-unit price in the PIPE Offering. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities held by V-Co 4 except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein.
